5
Honhom fam nipadua
1 # Hiob 4.19; 2 Pe 1.13-14 Na yɛnim sɛ, sɛ wɔnya dwiri yɛn asase so ntomadan yi a, yɛbɛnya efie a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn, ɛdan a wɔamfa nsa ansie, a ɛwɔ hɔ daa ɔsoro. 2#Rom 8.23 Ɛfiri sɛ yei mu deɛ, yɛsi apini na yɛn ani agyina sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ yɛn fie a ɛfiri soro no afoa so, 3ɛno na sɛ yɛhyɛ a, wɔrenhu yɛn adagya mu. 4#1 Ko 15.53 Na yɛn a yɛte ntomadan yi mu yi si apini na ɛhyɛ yɛn so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛbɛda adagya, na mmom yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ foa soɔ, na nkwa amene deɛ ɛwuo no. 5#2 Ko 1.22; Rom 8.16; 8.23; Efe 1.13-14 Na deɛ wasiesie yɛn ama saa adeɛ yi ne Onyankopɔn a ɔno ara ankasa de Honhom no dwaha nso ama yɛn no.
Ɔsoro fie
6 # Heb 11.13 Enti yɛhyɛ yɛn ho den daa, na yɛnim sɛ yɛte fie wɔ nipadua mu yi, yɛnte fie wɔ Awurade nkyɛn; 7#1 Ko 13.12 ɛfiri sɛ yɛnam gyidie mu, na ɛnyɛ anihunu so. 8#Flp 1.23 Na yɛwɔ saa awerɛhyɛmu yi, na ɛyɛ yɛn fɛ mmom sɛ yɛbɛfiri nipadua mu fie ha akɔtena efie wɔ Awurade nkyɛn. 9#Dwom 39.12 Enti nso yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ, sɛ yɛwɔ nipadua mu fie oo, yɛfiri hɔ oo, yɛbɛsɔ n’ani. 10#Aso 17.31; Rom 2.16; 14.10 Na ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛkɔpue Kristo atemmuo adwa no anim hɔ, na obiara anya deɛ ɔnam nipadua so yɛeɛ no, papa oo, bɔne oo, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ no.
Suro a wɔsuro ne dɔ a wɔdɔ Kristo
11Na sɛ yɛnim Awurade ho hu nti, yɛkasa kyerɛ nnipa sɛ wɔnhu no saa, na Onyankopɔn deɛ, yɛada adi ama no; na m’ani da so sɛ, yɛada adi wɔ mo ahonim mu nso. 12#2 Ko 3.1 Na yɛnsane nyi yɛn ho ayɛ nkyerɛ mo bio, na mmom yɛrema mo deɛ monam so bɛhoahoa mo ho yɛn fam, na moanya deɛ mode bɛbua wɔn a wɔhoahoa wɔn ho nnipa anim na ɛnyɛ akoma mu. 13Na sɛ yɛbɔ dam a, yɛbɔ ma Onyankopɔn; na sɛ yɛn adwene mu da hɔ a, ɛda ma mo. 14Na Kristo dɔ no kanyan yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛbu atɛn sɛ, ɔbaako wu maa wɔn nyinaa, enti na wɔn nyinaa awu. 15#1 Ti 2.6; Rom 14.7-8 Na ɔwu maa wɔn nyinaa na wɔn a wɔte aseɛ no antena ase amma wɔn ho bio, na mmom wɔatena ase ama deɛ ɔwuiɛ na wɔnyanee no maa wɔn no.
Nkwa adwene foforɔ
16Enti ɛfiri nnɛ yi, yɛnnim obiara honam fa mu; na sɛ yɛhunuu Kristo honam fa mu mpo a, afei deɛ yɛnnim no saa bio. 17#Rom 8.1; 8.10; Gal 6.15; Adi 21.5 Enti sɛ obi wɔ Kristo mu a, na ɔyɛ abɔdeɛ foforɔ; nnoɔma dada no atwa mu; hwɛ, nnoɔma nyinaa ayɛ foforɔ. 18#Rom 5.10 Na yei nyinaa firi Onyankopɔn a ɔnam Kristo so apata atwe yɛn afam ne ho, na ɔde nkabom som dwumadie ama yɛn no; 19#Rom 3.24-25; Kol 1.19-20 ɛne sɛ, Onyankopɔn wɔ Kristo mu a ɔrepata twe wiase fam ne ho, na wammu wɔn mfomsoɔ angu wɔn so, na wɔde nkabom asɛm no ahyɛ yɛn nsa.
Asomdwoeɛ ne ayɔnkofa ho kaseɛ
20 # Yes 52.7 Enti yɛyɛ abɔfoɔ ma Kristo, ɛte sɛ Onyankopɔn nam yɛn so retu foɔ; yɛgyina Kristo ananmu srɛ mo sɛ: Mo ne Nyankopɔn nka mmom. 21#Heb 4.15; Gal 3.13; 1 Ko 1.30; Flp 3.9 Ɛfiri sɛ, deɛ ɔnnim bɔne no, ɔde no yɛɛ bɔne maa yɛn, na yɛayɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee wɔ ne mu.

Na yɛnim sɛ, sɛ wɔnya dwiri yɛn asase so ntomadan yi a, yɛbɛnya efie a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn, ɛdan a wɔamfa nsa ansie, a ɛwɔ hɔ daa ɔsoro. Ɛfiri sɛ yei mu deɛ, yɛsi apini na yɛn ani agyina sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ yɛn fie a ɛfiri soro no afoa so, ɛno na sɛ yɛhyɛ a, wɔrenhu yɛn adagya mu. Na yɛn a yɛte ntomadan yi mu yi si apini na ɛhyɛ yɛn so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛbɛda adagya, na mmom yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ foa soɔ, na nkwa amene deɛ ɛwuo no. Na deɛ wasiesie yɛn ama saa adeɛ yi ne Onyankopɔn a ɔno ara ankasa de Honhom no dwaha nso ama yɛn no.

Enti yɛhyɛ yɛn ho den daa, na yɛnim sɛ yɛte fie wɔ nipadua mu yi, yɛnte fie wɔ Awurade nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛnam gyidie mu, na ɛnyɛ anihunu so. Na yɛwɔ saa awerɛhyɛmu yi, na ɛyɛ yɛn fɛ mmom sɛ yɛbɛfiri nipadua mu fie ha akɔtena efie wɔ Awurade nkyɛn. Enti nso yɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ, sɛ yɛwɔ nipadua mu fie oo, yɛfiri hɔ oo, yɛbɛsɔ n’ani. Na ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛkɔpue Kristo atemmuo adwa no anim hɔ, na obiara anya deɛ ɔnam nipadua so yɛeɛ no, papa oo, bɔne oo, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ no.

Na sɛ yɛnim Awurade ho hu nti, yɛkasa kyerɛ nnipa sɛ wɔnhu no saa, na Onyankopɔn deɛ, yɛada adi ama no; na m’ani da so sɛ, yɛada adi wɔ mo ahonim mu nso. Na yɛnsane nyi yɛn ho ayɛ nkyerɛ mo bio, na mmom yɛrema mo deɛ monam so bɛhoahoa mo ho yɛn fam, na moanya deɛ mode bɛbua wɔn a wɔhoahoa wɔn ho nnipa anim na ɛnyɛ akoma mu. Na sɛ yɛbɔ dam a, yɛbɔ ma Onyankopɔn; na sɛ yɛn adwene mu da hɔ a, ɛda ma mo. Na Kristo dɔ no kanyan yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛbu atɛn sɛ, ɔbaako wu maa wɔn nyinaa, enti na wɔn nyinaa awu. Na ɔwu maa wɔn nyinaa na wɔn a wɔte aseɛ no antena ase amma wɔn ho bio, na mmom wɔatena ase ama deɛ ɔwuiɛ na wɔnyanee no maa wɔn no.

Enti ɛfiri nnɛ yi, yɛnnim obiara honam fa mu; na sɛ yɛhunuu Kristo honam fa mu mpo a, afei deɛ yɛnnim no saa bio. Enti sɛ obi wɔ Kristo mu a, na ɔyɛ abɔdeɛ foforɔ; nnoɔma dada no atwa mu; hwɛ, nnoɔma nyinaa ayɛ foforɔ. Na yei nyinaa firi Onyankopɔn a ɔnam Kristo so apata atwe yɛn afam ne ho, na ɔde nkabom som dwumadie ama yɛn no; ɛne sɛ, Onyankopɔn wɔ Kristo mu a ɔrepata twe wiase fam ne ho, na wammu wɔn mfomsoɔ angu wɔn so, na wɔde nkabom asɛm no ahyɛ yɛn nsa.

Enti yɛyɛ abɔfoɔ ma Kristo, ɛte sɛ Onyankopɔn nam yɛn so retu foɔ; yɛgyina Kristo ananmu srɛ mo sɛ: Mo ne Nyankopɔn nka mmom. Ɛfiri sɛ, deɛ ɔnnim bɔne no, ɔde no yɛɛ bɔne maa yɛn, na yɛayɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee wɔ ne mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
